metadata.title: Honest Shortlist: Final Project Film
metadata.persona: none: Prathamesh's own first-person script, synthetic voice, disclosed in B00

beats.narration_text: I'm Prathamesh Pathak, and this is the film for my final project, Honest Shortlist. This synthetic voice is reading my script.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

shot.visual_intent: Title stack: 'Honest Shortlist', an ink rule, name, film line; the synthetic-voice disclosure lands last.
shot.motion_claim: Title stack: 'Honest Shortlist', an ink rule, name, film line; the synthetic-voice disclosure lands last.

beats.narration_text: Honest Shortlist will give an international network engineering student a short daily list of new jobs. Every claim about a posting will point to the sentence it rests on, or say the posting doesn't say.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

shot.visual_intent: One shortlist card: the 'sponsorship' row threads to a quoted-sentence slip; the last row gets the dash stamp 'posting doesn't say'.
shot.motion_claim: One shortlist card: the 'sponsorship' row threads to a quoted-sentence slip; the last row gets the dash stamp 'posting doesn't say'.

beats.narration_text: Why care? Sponsorship. On October twentieth, I checked seven network engineering postings at three employers. None offered sponsorship. Two required a security clearance, which, by inference, rules a visa holder out. Five said nothing at all.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

shot.visual_intent: Seven posting cards in a row; two get a cross (clearance required, inferred), five get a dash (silent); '0 offer sponsorship'.
shot.motion_claim: Seven posting cards in a row; two get a cross (clearance required, inferred), five get a dash (silent); '0 offer sponsorship'.

beats.narration_text: Company history doesn't settle it. Zoox had one thousand three hundred sixty-four H one B approvals, yet all three of its network postings were silent.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

shot.visual_intent: 'Zoox: 1,364 H-1B approvals' above a real console panel of its three silent network postings.
shot.motion_claim: 'Zoox: 1,364 H-1B approvals' above a real console panel of its three silent network postings.

beats.narration_text: What exists already? LinkedIn alerts send new matching postings. When I looked at LinkedIn's search results on October thirty-first, the match reasoning sat behind a click, a no-sponsorship requirement wasn't flagged, and closed postings still showed up.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

shot.visual_intent: Plain text, no logo or UI: one 'documented' line, then three dated notes from Prathamesh's own look.
shot.motion_claim: Plain text, no logo or UI: one 'documented' line, then three dated notes from Prathamesh's own look.
on_screen_labels: LinkedIn alerts: documented, not tested by me

beats.narration_text: A chat assistant, given one pasted posting, did better: it caught "eight plus years" and said the posting was silent on sponsorship. But it only knows what I paste. My own first version called that posting relevant.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

shot.visual_intent: Two verdict columns on the same posting: chat 'Not relevant · 8+ years · silent on sponsorship' vs 'my agent v1: relevant'.
shot.motion_claim: Two verdict columns on the same posting: chat 'Not relevant · 8+ years · silent on sponsorship' vs 'my agent v1: relevant'.

beats.narration_text: And the Reallocation Engine's existing fetcher silently dropped six hundred thirty-one of Shield AI's six hundred fifty-three postings, including every network posting with clearance wording. Its output still looked clean.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

shot.visual_intent: Two real console lines, then two bars to scale: 22 vs 653; '631 dropped · no error'.
shot.motion_claim: Two real console lines, then two bars to scale: 22 vs 653; '631 dropped · no error'.

beats.narration_text: So why mine? It will watch the boards itself, like an alert, show its evidence, like a careful reader, and say "silent" when a posting is silent.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

shot.visual_intent: Three-by-three grid of stamps: rows LinkedIn alerts / chat assistant / Honest Shortlist (planned); columns watches / evidence / says silent.
shot.motion_claim: Three-by-three grid of stamps: rows LinkedIn alerts / chat assistant / Honest Shortlist (planned); columns watches / evidence / says silent.

beats.narration_text: Here's how. The data will be public Greenhouse, Lever, and Ashby job feeds. No logins, no LinkedIn or Indeed scraping, and it will never apply, email, or message anyone.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

shot.visual_intent: Six blocks joined by arrows: fetch, new only, title rule, extract, label, re-fetch + approve; status above each: RAN / IN MODE / PLANNED.
shot.motion_claim: Six blocks joined by arrows: fetch, new only, title rule, extract, label, re-fetch + approve; status above each: RAN / IN MODE / PLANNED.
on_screen_labels: never: apply · email · message · log in

beats.narration_text: Step one already ran in JS2, on November tenth: one fetch per board, inside a budget. Four boards took four of six requests, and a deliberately bad board got a four-oh-four error, with no retry.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

shot.visual_intent: Real terminal panel from the JS2 live run; a dot marks the 404 line.
shot.motion_claim: Real terminal panel from the JS2 live run; a dot marks the 404 line.

beats.narration_text: Step two ran too: keep only new postings. Zoox had thirty-one new ones against my saved October state, and a title rule screens for network roles.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

shot.visual_intent: The zoox line with 'new=31' ringed; below, the real false-friend test name.
shot.motion_claim: The zoox line with 'new=31' ringed; below, the real false-friend test name.

beats.narration_text: Step three exists in my Reallocation mode, not yet in the agent: pull every sentence about sponsorship, authorization, or clearance. Step four is still to build: label each claim supported, contradicted, or insufficient, with a verbatim quote.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

shot.motion_claim: Real extraction line tagged IN MODE; below, three planned label stamps.

beats.narration_text: My JS1 validator already rejects any quote that isn't in the posting. Then a fresh fetch will confirm the posting is open, and I'll approve the final list.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

shot.visual_intent: Real test name and 'Ran 50 tests, OK' tagged RAN; two grey planned blocks: re-fetch, my approval.
shot.motion_claim: Real test name and 'Ran 50 tests, OK' tagged RAN; two grey planned blocks: re-fetch, my approval.

beats.narration_text: Do I have what I need? The boards need no account. The code is standard-library Python on my laptop. My Claude Code subscription handled the fifty judge calls in JS1. I haven't measured how far it stretches for daily runs across many boards.

shot.motion_claim: Checklist: three checked rows and one dash row.
on_screen_labels: daily runs, many boards: not measured

beats.narration_text: How will I know it worked? JS1 left a warning. All twenty test postings were not a fit, so always answering "not relevant" scored a hundred percent. Pass rate alone proved nothing.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

shot.visual_intent: Real result rows from the JS1 experiment; a cross stamp: 'pass rate alone proved nothing'.
shot.motion_claim: Real result rows from the JS1 experiment; a cross stamp: 'pass rate alone proved nothing'.

beats.narration_text: So I'll measure false positives, a "supported" label whose quote doesn't back the claim, and false negatives. For evaluation, I'll build a new held-out set of about forty postings from more boards, labelled by me before I see any output, including real entry-level fits and false friends.

shot.motion_claim: Planned held-out tray of cards in three groups; two empty meters: false positives, false negatives.

beats.narration_text: It worked if it finds most real fits without calling any clearance- or citizenship-only posting relevant, beats the always-insufficient baseline on those fits, and verify catches every planted failure.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

shot.motion_claim: Real SEEDED panel: agent 'finished exit=0', verify 'FAIL … 826 ids'; then the planned success bar.

beats.narration_text: Zero tolerance for calling a posting relevant when it rules out sponsorship. Missing a real fit is a rate I'll report, not a pass or fail. Every claim will carry its evidence, and silence will be called silence.
